packet.headline_seed: As crypto cools, a16zcrypto raises a $2.2B fund
packet.description_seed: As some of the biggest VCs in crypto start to consider funding AI startups, a16zcrypto's new fund will stay the course.

what: As crypto cools, a16zcrypto raises a $2.2B fund

clean_source_blocks.text: As some of the biggest VCs in crypto start to consider funding AI startups, a16zcrypto's new fund will stay the course.

In a blog post that lays out a vision for crypto’s future, ranging from a “new financial system” to warnings about “opaque” AI, a16zcrypto announced a new $2.2 billion fund. This is the VC firm’s fifth fund and brings the total raised to date to $9.8 billion, it says.

Andreessen Horowitz raised $2.2 billion for its fifth crypto fund, giving one of Silicon Valley’s most aggressive blockchain investors fresh capital to back startups building crypto infrastructure and consumer products.

The announcement came today, marking one of the larger fundraises in venture crypto this year. a16z Crypto didn’t waste time spelling out where the money goes—stablecoins and onchain finance sit at the top of the list. The firm thinks these areas will power the next big wave of crypto innovation, and they’re backing that view with serious capital. Stablecoins, which peg their value to traditional assets like the dollar, have grown fast. Transactions clear faster and cheaper than legacy rails, which is why adoption keeps climbing. a16z Crypto wants to fund projects building on that momentum.

original_article.research:
[Lähde: TechCrunch]
In a blog post that lays out a vision for crypto’s future, ranging from a “new financial system” to warnings about “opaque” AI, a16zcrypto announced a new $2.2 billion fund. This is the VC firm’s fifth fund and brings the total raised to date to $9.8 billion, it says.

In addition, the fund also promoted its CTO, Eddy Lazzarin, to General Partner, bringing the GP investing team to four people. Lazzarin joins Chris Dixon, Ali Yahya, and Guy Wuollet. The fund has backed standout companies like Coinbase, Kalshi, and Solana Foundation.

---

[Lähde: Live Bitcoin News]
Andreessen Horowitz has just indicated an enormous vote of confidence in the digital asset ecosystem. The venture capital giant, dubbed ‘a16z’, officially closed its most recent multibillion-dollar investment vehicle today. The introduction of Crypto Fund 5 is a turning point for blockchain innovation worldwide.

The firm raised $2.2 billion to support the next decade of decentralized development. This money will be directed toward entrepreneurs at all stages of the corporate lifecycle. As a result, a new wave of institutional capital and technical assistance is now expected in the industry.

The company will focus on projects that have high durability and utility. In particular, the team is scouting startups in the stablecoin and cross-border payments space.

Moreover, a16z has been ardently devoted to decentralized finance and tokenized physical assets. Crypto fund 5 will be the runway needed to scale these complex protocols.

In the process, the company seeks to address the disparity between conventional and digital finance.

We've raised $2.2B in committed capital to invest in the next generation of crypto.

Announcing Crypto Fund 5 https://t.co/1NOPfCMM9l

The size of the fund indicates a more disciplined and focused investment strategy. Though smaller than its 2022 predecessor, it is larger than most of its competitors. This strategic resizing makes Crypto Fund 5 stay nimble in a changing market.

Managing Partner Chris Dixon will lead the fund. a16z Crypto’s primary investment areas include stablecoins, tokenization, perpetual futures, prediction markets, and artificial intelligence agents.

The corporation explained its strategy, stating that software is getting more sophisticated and difficult to trust, whereas AI systems are powerful but opaque. It stated that in such a scenario, crypto network properties become more valuable.

According to the firm, the new fund’s founders are focused on creating goods that people use every day. Those regions may receive less attention, but they produce more long-term benefit.

The $2.2 billion increase underscores a huge investment relative to other recent venture rounds.

For instance, it doubles the size of recent raises by notable firms like Haun Ventures.

This scale will enable a16z to continue being a leading force in the crypto industry.

[Lähde: The Currency Analytics]
Andreessen Horowitz’s crypto arm just closed a $2.2 billion fund. The fifth vehicle from a16z Crypto targets stablecoins, onchain finance, and what the firm sees as improving regulatory conditions across the digital asset space.

The announcement came today, marking one of the larger fundraises in venture crypto this year. a16z Crypto didn’t waste time spelling out where the money goes—stablecoins and onchain finance sit at the top of the list. The firm thinks these areas will power the next big wave of crypto innovation, and they’re backing that view with serious capital. Stablecoins, which peg their value to traditional assets like the dollar, have grown fast. Transactions clear faster and cheaper than legacy rails, which is why adoption keeps climbing. a16z Crypto wants to fund projects building on that momentum.

The firm also promoted its CTO to general partner. That’s a big move. It signals a16z Crypto is doubling down on technical leadership as it deploys this massive fund across a shifting landscape.

The CTO promotion isn’t just a title change. It’s about bringing more technical depth to investment decisions. a16z Crypto manages a growing portfolio, and the firm wants someone with deep engineering chops at the partner table. The move came alongside the fundraising news, which probably isn’t a coincidence.

The firm’s focus on stablecoins makes sense right now. These digital currencies offer a bridge between traditional finance and crypto. They’re less volatile than Bitcoin or Ethereum, so people actually use them for payments and savings. Stablecoin transaction volumes have surged over the past year, and a16z Crypto clearly sees that trend continuing. The firm didn’t name specific projects it plans to back, but the emphasis on scalability and widespread adoption suggests they’re hunting for infrastructure plays—stuff that can handle serious transaction volume.

Onchain finance is the other big bucket. That’s basically decentralized financial services: lending, trading, derivatives, all running on blockchain rails instead of through banks. a16z Crypto thinks this sector can redefine how financial services work globally. It’s a bold bet, but the firm has the capital and the track record to chase it.

payload.title: Andreessen Horowitz keräsi 2,2 miljardin dollarin uuden kryptorahaston
payload.summary: Andreessen Horowitzin kryptosijoitusyksikkö a16z Crypto on kerännyt viidennen kryptorahastonsa, jonka koko on 2,2 miljardia dollaria. Yhtiö aikoo jatkaa kryptosektorin rahoittamista aikana, jolloin osa alan pääomasijoittajista katsoo yhä enemmän tekoälystartupien suuntaan.
payload.content:
Andreessen Horowitzin kryptosijoitusyksikkö a16z Crypto on ilmoittanut keränneensä 2,2 miljardin dollarin uuden rahaston kryptoyhtiöihin sijoittamista varten. Kyseessä on yhtiön viides kryptorahasto, ja sen myötä a16z Crypton tähän mennessä keräämä kokonaispääoma nousee yhtiön mukaan 9,8 miljardiin dollariin.

## Rahasto jatkaa kryptolinjalla

Uusi rahasto tulee markkinaan tilanteessa, jossa kryptosektorin kuumin kasvu on viilentynyt aiemmista huippuvuosista. Samalla osa kryptoon keskittyneistä pääomasijoittajista on alkanut tarkastella entistä aktiivisemmin tekoäly-yhtiöitä, jotka ovat houkutelleet runsaasti rahoitusta ja huomiota.

A16z Crypto viestii kuitenkin jatkavansa samalla linjalla. Rahasto on tarkoitettu startup-yrityksille, jotka rakentavat kryptoinfrastruktuuria ja kuluttajille suunnattuja kryptotuotteita. Yhtiö asemoi sijoituksensa osaksi näkemystä, jossa kryptoteknologioilla voi olla rooli uudenlaisen rahoitusjärjestelmän rakentamisessa.

Rahaston koko tekee siitä yhden merkittävimmistä kryptopääoman keräyksistä tänä vuonna. Se myös osoittaa, että ainakin osa Piilaakson suurista sijoittajista näkee lohkoketju- ja kryptoyhtiöissä edelleen pitkän aikavälin mahdollisuuksia, vaikka markkinan yleinen tunnelma on muuttunut varovaisemmaksi.

## Stablecoinit ja ketjussa tapahtuva rahoitus painopisteinä

Rahaston keskeisiksi painopisteiksi on nostettu stablecoinit ja niin sanottu onchain-rahoitus eli lohkoketjuissa tapahtuvat rahoituspalvelut. Stablecoinit ovat kryptovaluuttoja, joiden arvo pyritään sitomaan perinteisiin omaisuuseriin, kuten Yhdysvaltain dollariin.

A16z Crypton näkemyksen mukaan näillä alueilla voi syntyä seuraava merkittävä kryptoinnovaation aalto. Perusteluna on muun muassa se, että stablecoineihin liittyvät maksutapahtumat voivat selvitä nopeammin ja edullisemmin kuin perinteisissä maksujärjestelmissä.

Yhtiö on myös liittänyt krypton tulevaisuuskuvaansa huolen tekoälyn läpinäkymättömyydestä. Sen viesti on, että hajautetut teknologiat voivat tarjota vastapainoa järjestelmille, joiden toimintaa käyttäjien on vaikea arvioida. Uusi rahasto antaa a16z Cryptolle huomattavan määrän pääomaa tämän näkemyksen edistämiseen.
